sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/368 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: place 368, grids 526-527 and search/details for every unit, 2027-06-15; sampled units on 2027-06-19, 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12; read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Every RV site has electric: $37 a night; premium electric (deck) sites $41; full hookups $50; the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) all three $33 (full-service sites have no water then). Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. The bridle camp's $23 sites are for horse campers. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Paint Creek campsites, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 37.00, Premium Electric 41.00, Full Hookup 50.00, Equestrian Non-Electric 23.00); units 002, 027 and 001 on Sat 2027-06-19 (37.00 / 41.00 / 50.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (33.00 each), Fee 6.50, read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '20/30/50'; full-hookup sites list water and sewer hookups) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/paint-creek-state-park-campground ('electric and full hookup'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 194 web-bookable RV sites in the family campground, all back-in: 169 electric (pads 36-56 ft), 15 premium electric deck sites (38-50 ft) and 10 full hookup (40-52 ft). Plus two camper cabins and a separate 10-site bridle camp south of the lake. Pet-friendly sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid 526 + search/details (IsRVSite true, Pad Length, PullInTypeName 'Back In') + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/paint-creek-state-park-campground ('nearly 200 sites', 'some premium deck sites', 'A small bridle camp with 10 primitive campsites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Showerhouses with flush toilets and laundry; camp store (walk-in registration); disc golf course. Off-peak the showerhouse, dump station and water stay open.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/paint-creek-state-park-campground ('Showerhouses, flush toilets, laundry facilities', 'Dump station', 'Walk-Ins ... can be reserved at the camp store', 'Off-peak Season ... Showerhouse, dump station, and water are available'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Off-peak November 1 to March 31: sites 1-64 are available; full-service sites have no water at the site.

season.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/paint-creek-state-park-campground ('Off-peak Season: November 1 to March 31, sites 1-64 are available') + ReserveOhio off-peak prices for 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30

values.note: 'Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727. Walk-Ins are available for open sites and can be reserved at the camp store.' 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

note: Family campground on a wooded peninsula on the north side of Paint Creek Lake; the premium deck sites sit near the shore at the peninsula's south-west edge (27-38) and its tip (108-119). --Claude
summary: Fees changed 37/37 -> 37/41 (premium deck sites as the high end; full-hookup surcharge +13 kept). Added hookups 50/W/S, 194 back-in RV sites to 56 ft, showers/flush/laundry/dump/store, year-round season (sites 1-64 in winter), ReserveOhio booking (180 days, max 14).
